profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at XOS (Danaher Corporation)
profile.summary: Specialties: Full Stack Software Enginering, Javascript, C#,Java, Ansible, Gradle, AWS, SQL, AngularJS, JUnit, Big Data, Spark, Hive, Kubernetes

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: East Greenbush, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Full stack development of new generation of Analyzers
•	Helped an emerging team achieve industry standards by using Scrum, establishing a defined CI/CD, and enforcing better practices in software quality and maintenance, and mainly promoting collaboration among the team.
•	Part of the team that develops the UI in JavaFx, the core in Java, a H2 backend that runs in Raspbian. The system is entirely automated using Gradle as a build system and tests in TestFx.
•	Developed libraries and tools that facilitate the serial communication with the firmware of the instrument.
•	Enhanced the functionality of the instrument by adding network sharing capabilities (SCP, SMB, FTP), advanced printing configuration and monitoring, multiuser support, security and an improved fault reporting system.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Development, Cloud Native, Kubernetes, Big Data.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Location Intelligence for Hadoop
•	Part of the team that develops hive/spark/mapreduce applications that run in Hadoop.
•	Automated provisioning of AWS EMR, Hortonworks, and Cloudera cluster platforms using Ansible and Gradle scripts.

Map Uploader
•	Part of the team that developed a C# - WPF application that runs inside MapInfo Pro, and publishes map content to the cloud. Backend server work included a new RESTful endpoint which enables the creation of maps and layers with style and theme information.
•	This project was a great interoperability task where we were connecting a desktop product with a server/cloud product, and providing great UX as the tool operates asynchronous, avoiding flickering or frozen screens while operating the tool. Learned a lot about software versioning, how to handle released version and to plan for future versions of the tool.

Spatial Server
•	Part of the team that developed the front end for the management of the resources in the server. Point and click functionality plus a RESTful API have replaced the tedious xml editing, and uploading downloading of files. The application was developed in AngularJS, and JAXRS, and heavily tested using Karma, Jasmine, and Protractor.
•	Now users can see the maps right away as a thumbnail, or using the interactive map option. 
•	Learned a ton about software maintainability, scalability, readability, reusability, and throughput.
•	Several bug fixes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
MapInfo Professional
• Contribute in the development of a Data Provider for FDO SQLite, for better interoperability with Autodesk Map 3D. Fascinating project with a WPF - C# front end, and managed C++ and C in the lower layers.

MapInfo Manager
• Developed a servlet application for managing geographical metadata. The application was developed using Groovy on Grails, and Java in the backend. JavaScript, Json and the Dojo Toolkit were used in the front end.
• Part of a team spread in different geographies: Toronto, Troy, and New Delhi.  Our team uses Scrum, we manage our backlog in Jira, and build the product in Teamcity.

Catalog Browser for MapInfo Professional
• This project allows users to browse through metadata catalogs, was developed in C#, XAML, and MapBasic. It runs as an Add-On in MapInfo Professional.  
• Additional tasks on this project included: performance testing, learning the CSW 2.0.2 specification standard, and sample metadata creation.

Routing Java Server 3.4
• Brought back to life the testing system for our Routing Java Server. I ported code from an earlier version of Java to Java 1.5. Rewrote unit, and functional tests. Setup the build system through Ant scripts, and migrated the original project to a Eclipse project. 

MapXtreme API 7.0 and MapXtreme API 6.8
• Added Tests to our API to support Microsoft SQL 2008 new data types (geometry and geography), and helped adding support for new coordinate systems, and a map tiling server.
• Testing the MapXtreme API. Developed lots of unit and integration tests. Created performance tests using Silk Performer, debugging and logging failures in our bugs database, testing the installer package, testing the API in different locales using Virtual machines in Japanese, German, Chinese, and Danish.
• Develop geographical information systems applications using the MapXtreme API in VB.net and C#.
• Maintain testing machines and keeping up to date the MapInfo Test System servers and clients, to test our API daily.

positions.title: Application Programmer
positions.description:
Part of a team for designing, developing and maintaining web applications.
Worked on .Net Technologies (VB .Net, ASP.Net and SQL Server 2005) and Web Technologies (HTML, Javascript, CSS) for the creation of the web application for the Family Resource Centers of New York State, AmeriCorps, and the Collocation Program of New York State.
Developed a survey program for screen touch computers.

positions.title: Systems Support Specialist
positions.description:
Added a section of the website to handle Variable Annuities.
Created Scripts to streamline network duties.
Worked on Several Programs for Microsoft Office and Outlook
User and Desktop Support.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Created Software for Palm Devices.
Created Software for the chip of the Partisol 210. (Air quality measurement Instrument)
Worked on a Bluetooth library.

positions.title: Systems Support
positions.description:
Wrote a .net application for software licensing purposes.
Streamlined users desktop deployment by writing several vbscripts.
Maintenance and support for all the computers in the three libraries.
Used Active Directory Group Policies
Used Norton Ghost Software for PC Imaging.
